H8 has fewer static instructions800 versus H7 841, but its larger register allocation and explicit LDG-to-register/STS staging distinguish it from the cp.async path. These facts alone do not establish an occupancy bottleneck.
On the recorded square128–1024 cases H8 event time is larger than H7 in both dtypes. No claim of a statistically paired win or kernel floor is made.
